display_name: Wire fence strainer end assembly (post, brace, diagonal)

axes.note: Blender axes; FBX recipe maps +Y(left) -> UE -Y

lod_info: Nanite-ready opaque mesh; no manual LODs (UE auto)
usage: Corner / end strainer for the wire fence: strainer post on the origin, brace runs 1.5 m to +X. Rotate 180 deg to close the far end.
uv: UVMap = metric box projection (1 UV unit = 1 m) for tiling materials; vertex colour Col = per-part tint (white default)
